experiment: R2 (S&P 2027): quarantine soundness and over-quarantine on the saved real-deployment verifier snapshots

window.chain_upper_bound: the recorder snapshot time; roots anchored after it are excluded because the snapshot cannot account for them

deleted_event_time_bound_support.scope: lock-domain call_service events and lock state rows sharing their context, in [t_start, t_end]
deleted_event_time_bound_support.reading: lag >= 0 supports event <= its state row; ulid delta >= 0 supports context creation <= event

universe.definition: surviving snapshot nodes (states + events, the monitor's load()) with ts in [span_lo, span_hi), the time span of the verified anchored segments

per_trial_R5_quarantine.what: surviving nodes in the R5 regions that this trial's own tampered elements fall in (regions may be shared with other trials)

per_trial_OQ.what: each policy applied to the violated segments that contain this trial's own tampered elements; mean over trials of |Q - T| / |U|

per_trial_R5_quarantine.what: surviving nodes in the R5 regions that this trial's own tampered elements fall in (regions may be shared with other trials)

per_trial_OQ.what: each policy applied to the violated segments that contain this trial's own tampered elements; mean over trials of |Q - T| / |U|

definitions.soundness: trial sound iff every element it tampered (updated state rows: snapshot ts; deleted events: id gap, ts interval [max(ULID(ctx), ts(prev id)), min(ts(row_before), ts(next id))]) lies inside the policy's quarantined time regions; R5 regions = localize.greedy_regions, half-open [lo,hi) as metrics.lr_regions (R5_homeprov_closed: stage24's closed-interval check); R1 = stage24 win(w) closed; R2 = stage24 innermost() (minimum-width violated segments) closed; R0 = [min ts, max ts] of U; R4 = R5 regions plus R4's node set (DEVIATION: stage24 uses one hull interval over R4's nodes, which on a multi-trial run spans the whole run and is vacuous)
definitions.indeterminate: a deleted event whose bounding interval is only partly quarantined
definitions.verification: e_c_write_time.verify_window semantics; first-write-wins roots from chain records with payload ts in [t_start, recorder_snapshot_at]; segments with start in [t_start-w, t_end+w]

provenance.sqlite_open: file:<path>?mode=ro&immutable=1 (uri=True) for every open, including the shipped monitor's load() via a sqlite3 shim
